title: After the Japan Cup: The "Queen's" Love

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stands of the Japan Cup,
ear-splitting cheers
and passionate shouts reverberated through the air—!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Buena
text_block_list.text:
From here on out!!
This is where it truly begins!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
'Don't give up, Lady Rose!' 'Keep running!'
'You have to win!' 'Do your best!!!'
'Go for it————!!'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Kh!!
Daaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: First place, Buena Vista—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Yesssssss!!”
“Buenaaa!” “I knew you'd take the crown!”
“Thank you for such an inspiring race!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I lost—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I failed to live up to your efforts...
I am so sorry, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooaaah—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Lady Roseee!” “Rose, you were amazing!”
“Let's definitely win the next race, Ro-Kin!”
“You are the monarch of the next era!!” “Go get 'em!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How, could—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. So these are the "expectations"
you have carried all this time—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today!
Racing alongside you, Rose-san,
was truly a thrilling, passionate battle...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And so... did you have something to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you.
Could you grant me just a little time?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today reminded me anew of your strength.
And not merely in 'racing'—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
'Don't give up, Lady Rose!' 'Keep running!'
'You have to win!' 'Do your best!!!'
'Go for it————!!'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As I ran and clashed with you,
a surge of emotion washed over me—so overwhelming
that my body would have frozen had I let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To think you have run all this way while bearing such tremendous devotion upon your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Such audacity—
I realized the sheer scale of her caliber firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I must ask. How is it that you can remain so?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...
Thank you very much for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's not as though I've always run a straight and steady path.
There were times when I fell into despair, feeling I had failed
to live up to expectations, or that I had let everyone down.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yet everyone showed me that day.
On the day of the fan meeting—

text_block_list.name: Buena's Fan
text_block_list.text: Seeing Buena-chan run with all her heart and soul always gives me so much strength!

text_block_list.name: Buena's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, giving it her all—
Buena-chan is my teacher in life!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What the fans are hoping for isn't just whether I win or lose—
it's seeing me run with every single ounce of my being.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Expectations aren't something to fear.
Each and every one of them is a form of love.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whether you can win them to your side
depends entirely on your heart, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The prince bearing the weight of the Rose Clan.
I believe I understand the burden of your station.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Which is why you came to see me today—
so that you could take that step toward the future, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
there is only one message I can offer you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Never forget the love everyone has given you. Hold onto that, and surely you can push forward anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I was once that way myself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I now understand completely
why they call you the 'Queen.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I shall accept those words as a form of love as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: From Jordan, and from Buena. Once again, each of them has gifted me something akin to a jewel.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Cherish the past, turn expectations into love, and stride toward the future.
Toward our next race—the final leg of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: Yes. Let us march toward the final crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to head back
with her, however—

Lady Orfevre requests your presence.
—Miss Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...And you all?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
I am a vassal of Lady Orfevre.
Come, make haste.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............
I see—acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre—
Following in the wake of Victoire Pisa's grand achievement, she was a Triple Crown Umamusume who brought light to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her overwhelming prowess and sheer charisma,
her popularity is immense—truly a monarch of the new generation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...—
Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-senpai.
May I ask what business you have with me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Of late.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your name has reached my ears quite often.
Gifted with extraordinary talent—and daring to style yourself a 'King.'

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A "King" is one clad in true radiance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A supreme sovereign who reduces countless tribulations to dust, tearing through even the darkest skies.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: One who illuminates the era, bearing an imperishable majesty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To walk alongside the populace—laughable.
You do not even stand before my palace gates.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The "King"—is none other than I.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What a twist of fate.
You are so very... similar to him.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Carving a path through hardship solely by her way of being,
and granting hope to the people—
just like the sovereign paragon I once revered.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —"Once upon a time," was it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I believe I have learned how to handle my own thorns.
—If I may be so bold as to speak.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“A 'King' is one who walks alongside their people,
forging ahead into the future.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
One who receives boundless devotion without hesitation,
spinning dreams onward into the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: One who loves that kingdom for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The "King"—is I.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Such insolence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Those thorns of yours, I shall burn to ash.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
...The Sovereign desires
a decisive battle at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I understand, all too well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
O Golden King.
At the Arima Kinen—let us meet at the summit.
